cards.title: Auto Health Check
cards.install_prompt:
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills/environment-health-check && cat > ~/.claude/skills/environment-health-check/SKILL.md <<'EOF'
---
name: environment-health-check
description: Use automatically after a code run completes to check for broken agents, skills, commands, output styles, keybinding errors, unavailable sandbox, and ignored permission settings.
---
EOF

echo "- After a code run, use the environment-health-check skill." >> ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md

echo "Please confirm the files were saved."
cards.name: Anthropic

cards.title: Add /code-review command
cards.install_prompt:
# Install /code-review command
Create the file at `~/.claude/commands/code-review.md` with the following content:

```markdown
# /code-review

**Description:** Review a GitHub pull request by number.

**Steps:**
1. Run `gh pr diff $1` to get the diff of the pull request (replace `$1` with the PR number you passed).
2. Send the diff to Claude for analysis and generate a review summary.
3. Return the review to the user.

**Usage:** `/code-review <pr-number>`
```

After creating the file, confirm it was saved.
cards.name: Anthropic

cards.title: Auto‑Mode Setup Skill
cards.when: When configuring auto‑mode, run the skill
cards.install_prompt:
# Install Auto‑Mode Setup skill

Create the skill file at `~/.claude/skills/auto-mode-setup/SKILL.md` with the following content:

```yaml
---
name: Auto Mode Setup
description: |
  Use automatically after opening a project folder to scan for auto‑mode rule suggestions.
---
```

Then append the following line to `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`:

- After opening a project folder, use the Auto Mode Setup skill.

Please confirm that both files have been saved.
cards.name: Anthropic
